drought.alt: Dry brown soil cracked into many pieces, with a few dead leaves and twigs on top.

eruption.alt: Glowing orange lava breaks through dark hardened lava rock.

exhibition.alt: Paintings stand on wooden easels in rows along a bright hall with a tiled floor.

exit.alt: A glowing green exit sign with arrows shines in a dark room.

field.alt: An aerial view of farm fields with neat green and brown crop rows and a few workers.

flood.alt: Fast grey flood water rushes over and around a floating dock on a swollen river.

fog.alt: Thick fog hides most of a hillside village above dark pine trees.

foggy.alt: A cycle path and small wooden bridge disappear into pink morning fog.

freezer.alt: Two clear freezer drawers hold bread wrapped in plastic bags.

golf.alt: A greenkeeper mows the smooth green of a golf course under a cloudy sky.

grill.alt: Sausages, corn and courgette cook on a small barbecue grill while people stand around it.

hook.alt: A metal hook on a turnbuckle rests on a woven wire mesh.
